about.description: Single-stock perpetual market tracking Qualcomm Incorporated. Users get linear exposure to Qualcomm share-price moves without owning shares, shareholder rights, or dividend claims, with pricing referencing an external 24/5 equity feed. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDC. Markets are visible on Hyperliquid under the xyz namespace, but are operated by trade[XYZ] rather than listed as core Hyperliquid perps.
